what: When the large Footer wordmark reaches 95% of the screen, the letters rise from below (120%) in a randomly drawn order, each delayed .03s more, over 1.2s power4.inOut, and only the last character (a dot like an apostrophe) pops from 0 after 1s with .6s back.out(.9). Once all are standing, a letter you hover shrinks to .05x in .6s and then wobbles back up over 1.8s elastic.out(1, .8).

options.[data-fx-part=pop]: (If any) dot or apostrophe that pops larger at the end

note: While rising, anything outside the panel is clipped (overflow hidden), and once fully up it is released so the wobble is visible outside the panel too

from.where: shared.js initFooter() · Footer mark .nt-foot__mark on every page
